summary.text: Suzanna Karatassos is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 120 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Ward Black for an open seat.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she named expanding Medicaid, protecting voting access and funding public schools as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Suzanna Karatassos earned a high school diploma from Clarke Central High School, a bachelor's degree from the Savannah College of Art and Design in 2006 and a graduate degree from Academy of Art University in 2012.
Her career experience includes working as a content creator and as a real estate salesperson.
Karatassos advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her top priority is expanding Medicaid, and she also called for fully funding public schools and paying teachers competitive salaries.
